title: [Back Order] Alienware 39 5K OLED Gaming Monitor - AW3926QW $1,499 (RRP $1,999) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Back Order] Alienware 39 5K OLED Gaming Monitor - AW3926QW $1,499 (RRP $1,999) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[pw2002au] If you can afford a gaming PC today this is peanuts added to the overall cost ..
[kaybrr] The tenants are in a recession, the landlords are not
[Bruceflix] The gpu required to drive 5k ultrawide suggests the $1k isn't a barrier
[Jugganautx] People spending 30,000 on a brand new car? Wow I thought we were in a recession
[Moath] $30k for a new car is for like a Japanese hatchback - while your joke isn’t lost on me, it’s just a very very low cost to claim for a new car
[Agret] I also use mine to edit movies/photos and to watch movies/TV/anime.
If it was just to play games there are far cheaper options like the Samsung Odyssey line which are fantastic for just gaming.
[Believ3r] Ordered, hope it’s an improvement over the g9 oled oddysey
[REEGZ] Decent review:
https://www.reddit.com/r/ultrawidemasterrace/comments/1w3vf3…
[A-ron] anything is better then the g series experience
[longxa762] Has anyone test the monitor dual mode? Every review I see people just push through with their 5090, kinda want to know if it's even playable at that resolution or I should just get the aw3426dw
[tightm8] I’m waiting for the LG 42 C6 on Black Friday. Will snap one up the moment it gets close to $1k which I think is possible.
[lewl] The aw3426dw is also on sale for $1199 with next day delivery
Cheaper even after the 15% off you get when speaking to the sales assistant from Dell
[dottjt] Can you please explain what you mean by speaking to the sales assistant from Dell? Isn't this an amazon purchase?
[MoonSky] You can speak to Dell chat, and they can get you 15% off. 15% off the current Dell price, isn’t as good as Amazon
[doggmatic] How are Amazon doing it cheaper than Dell?
[vorsprung] I can't even back order it. Click buy it now or add to cart and you get an error page.
[djmm] I ordered the original LG 39" because my impatient arse couldn't wait for a few months lol
[keongyip] I saw this earlier today and purchased, it's 1999 direct from Dell. Hoping they'll honour it!
[erd] Sold out in half hour. Dear RBA, please look away.
[pineapple12] Is this monitor ok for playing fps games from time to time? I have an old 34" at the moment which I love, but this looks great. Also, would it be too big to stack another monitor on top?
[CrispyChrispy] Is this monitor ok for playing fps games from time to time?
Why wouldn't it be?
I have an old 34" at the moment which I love, but this looks great.
Then why upgrade?
Also, would it be too big to stack another monitor on top?
Depends, do you like neck pain?
[pineapple12] I've seen mixed reviews for FPS gaming on this monitor, I haven't tried it myself so I'm unsure if its any good for that. I want to upgrade my old 34" as its IPS and about 4 years old and not sure whether to get this or the other alienware 34.. I already have stacked monitors and it works well, I just haven't tried it with a monitor this big before.
[Grayjay] I find 165hz is too low for FPS games now, and the dual mode looks ass.
I'm waiting for a potential 240hz version next year.
[luizmarin] I love my AW3821DW so much; this will defnetly be the replacement once a good promo shows up
[Wuchang] Those who bought last month in shambles?
[Merlict] Eh, paying a bit more but getting 3 months of use isn't a big deal
[Wuchang] Copium? The ad was 23/7, you received in August, that’s one month not 3 lol you paid $300 more for one month. Need mental gymnastics style copium to tell yourself it is good hahahahaha
[Fredfloresjr] Ahaha justifying $300 is worth it for a month use 🤣🤣
[JoeyJoeJoe] I just bought a top of the line PC and on my Alienware 34” (3440x1440 -2.5K), I still have to scale thing down on MSFS2020. What’s the point of 5K let alone 4K?
[neosin] 2.5k is not top of line pc bud lol!
A 5080 is like that price now haha!
[JoeyJoeJoe] Dude, u missed the point. It’s not my current monitor that sux, it’s the games demanding so much more beyond current technology which don’t even allow seamless 4K, let alone 5K.
A 5080 helps a bit, but still doesn’t permit seamless 4K in Msfs2020.
[ToodlesNoodles] Compared to the g95sd for the same price which is better
